title: Mercy of God
definition: The mercy of God is His compassionate kindness toward sinners, sufferers, and those in need, withholding deserved judgment and extending help, forgiveness, and care.
summary: God's mercy reaches sinners, sufferers, failures, and the broken with compassion and help.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the mercy of God through His compassion, forgiveness, sacrifice, and ministry to the broken.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's mercy is one of the most beautiful themes in Scripture. Though humanity deserves judgment because of sin, God responds with compassion, patience, and grace. His mercy reaches people in failure, suffering, weakness, and need. Every believer stands as a testimony to God's mercy, receiving forgiveness and help that could never be earned.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people live under guilt, shame, or the belief that they have exhausted God's patience. Understanding His mercy reminds believers that God's compassion is greater than their failures.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: When you fail, run toward God rather than away from Him. Receive His mercy with gratitude and extend that same mercy to others. Let God's compassion shape how you treat people who struggle.
